summary: Marketing is pivoting to prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China programs while managing a wave of event and content deliverables due this week.
summaryDetail: The core focus right now is executing the SEO and marketing prioritization decision, with Asia Star and Intelligent China as top programs; Joseph is drafting target areas and prompts, and the team is analyzing existing participants and CRM leads to define target audiences. Urgent this week: finalize and share the Asia Start May edition full video and Australian participant spotlight video, follow up on the third brand video draft with BC, and complete the EV event summary for Zongchao and CCG, including confirming Dean Xiang's speaking slot at Tech in Asia. Also, TIAN Xuefang must update the report cover/header/footer with Midori by Aug 26 and confirm overseas social media ad selection results. The website redesign is in feedback phase, with Joseph to share the HTML alternative design, and the team to provide specific input. Meanwhile, resolve the Outlook credential lockout by updating all devices and contacting JSB, and handle SwissCham membership renewal by providing bank statement and invoice details. Upcoming: Sep 1 Shanghai EV event with updated LinkedIn post, and Tech in Asia Conference on Sept 16 with Dean Xiang speaking.
